newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume picks up on lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume picks up on lower prices.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange picked up on Monday to 783 kilos from Friday's 417 kilos as prices fell slightly, European markets, dealers said.
Gold eased in dollar terms to $348.00 kilos an ounce from $349.00 on Thursday and slipped slightly in lira terms to 1,475,000 per gram, compared 1,482,000 lira on Friday.
The drop in lira terms was slowed down by the lira's fall against the dollar. The Turkish currency eased to 131,960 lira per dollar, versus the previous close of 131,350 lira.
Most of the day's trade -- 768 kilos -- occurred in the morning session, with 96.8 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
